answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in lotus, expire in trellis, and plume lists each expiry. An farming party running 67 aliases therefore needs 102 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 817 identities would post 4846 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
